newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wang NZ buys Imaging Solutions Ltd.
newsitem.headline: Wang NZ buys Imaging Solutions Ltd.

text.p: Wang New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought information technology company Imaging Solutions Ltd.
The privately owned company specialises in document management, text retrieval, and workflow and imaging.
It employs 23 people in offices in Auckland and Wellington, and had turnover in 1996 of around NZ$2.6 million.
Customers include major organisations in government, banking, legal, local government and commercial markets.

Wang NZ's acquisition and new ventures manager, John Quirk, said the move signalled the completion of Wang's internal re-engineering process and the beginning of a phase of accelerated growth using accumulated cash to buy information technology companies.
Wang said ISL would operate as an independent, stand-alone subsidiary.
Blue Star Office Technology, a unit of U.S. Office Products, owns almost 98 percent of Wang NZ.
